# Youssef Salem — Portfolio (Flutter Web)

> Official public portfolio for Youssef Salem, Flutter developer (Egypt). Use this file for a concise machine-readable summary of the site.

## Site URL

- Home: https://youssef-salem-portfolio.vercel.app/

## What this site is

Personal engineering portfolio: responsive Flutter Web app (PWA-capable) deployed on Vercel. Sections cover about, skills, experience, projects (with per-project case studies), certificates, and a contact form.

## Language

User interface is available in **English** and **Arabic** (locale toggle in-app).

## Profiles (authoritative)

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/youssef-hassan-8529372b7/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@JoeCodezFlutter
- Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/~0124b005ef2bb3f524

## Technology

- **Stack:** Flutter Web, `go_router`, `flutter_bloc`, `get_it`, ARB localization.
- **Hosting:** Vercel; root path `/`.
